rows.object: A concrete finite spectral selection pinning the instance n = 16, k = 50000 (m=15, s=8, q_*=101/100, alpha_*^2 = 99853/100000): selected dimension 46785605044474340387088811257657817010714687366486217934111 versus h_50000(R^16) = 46779709349146362239266126538609505511855492134986686636251, strict surplus 5895695327978147822684719048311498859195231499531297860, from exact eigenvalue data num/den with Hopf multiplicities and isqrt upper bounds.
rows.published: build/sections/finite-selection.tex lines 1-95 (parameters, isqrt bound, eigenvalue data, the three integers); verification/counting-check.py and verification/counting-check-output.txt (recorded 3.4 s).
rows.size: degrees ~49,964-50,212 checked individually; 59-digit integers
rows.check: Recount the selected multiplicities with exact integers and compare against the Euclidean harmonic-polynomial dimension in R^16 at k = 50000. Seconds. Note: the paper calls this supplementary; the analytic existence argument does not depend on it, so it decides the concrete instance, not the proof.

rows.title: The critical dimension for one-phase Bernoulli minimizers
rows.claim: every nonzero one-homogeneous global minimizer in dimensions at most six is flat, while a nonflat one-homogeneous global minimizer exists in dimension seven.
rows.object: A universal algebraic certificate (Prop. cert:universal): rational, orthogonally equivariant tensor polynomials f, U, K, M, P over trace-free tensors on R^5, with constants a = 29/50, Q = 250000, eps_* = 438907/12000000, delta_* = 6984137359/31250000000, satisfying an interior inequality I >= eps_*(z^2+|l|^2) whenever chi >= 0 and a boundary inequality S >= delta_*. It powers the flatness half (dimensions <= 6); the dimension-7 example is the known De Silva-Jerison cone.
rows.published: build/sections/certificate.tex (constants line 11, Prop. cert:universal line 33, eq cert:interior line 51, eq cert:boundary line 65); coefficient data build/appendices/tables.tex (decoding line 13, Table I line 58, Table II line 297, reproduction line 922; 1,714 nonzero keys); exact proof build/sections/certificate-proof.tex (eq cert:exact-interior-sums line 507, eq cert:upper-matrix line 529); code and data verification/checks/reproduce.py, generate_tables.py, original/checks/*, and an independent engine verification/independent-certificate/{engine.py,bounds.py,output/coefficients.json,results.json}.
rows.size: tensor polynomials on R^5 with 1,714 nonzero coefficient keys; final 4x4 rational matrix comparisons
rows.check: Decode Table I/II, re-expand the interior and boundary expressions symbolically over Q (equivariant tensor contractions on R^5), and recheck the Gram/PSD decomposition giving I >= eps_*(z^2+|l|^2) and S >= delta_*. Minutes.

rows.title: Stable self-similar blowup for a supercritical defocusing Schrödinger equation on the torus
rows.claim: We prove stable self-similar finite-time blowup for a supercritical defocusing nonlinear Schrodinger equation on the twelve-dimensional torus.
rows.object: Exact integer/rational coefficient enclosures of truncated confluent-hypergeometric (Laguerre-recurrence) polynomials, with an integer box (H_0 = 10^8, B = 33477607, S = 270506819), used to count all low-angular roots and produce a nonzero profile-matching degree; positivity of comparison polynomials (e.g. 7 rational coefficients, all differences strictly positive) for the high-angular degrees.
rows.published: build/sections/certificates.tex (Appendix cert:arithmetic; coefficient enclosures and product rule eq cert:product-rule; integer box eq cert:integer-box ~line 38); verification/certificates/exact_verifier.py (428 lines), original_exact_certificates.py (245 lines), RESULTS.json, SHA256SUMS, README.md.
